title: Design System: Tsholofelo Ndawonde — Personal Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero headline only. Geist, 700 weight, text-5xl–text-7xl, tight/negative tracking. Copy capped at 3-5 words to justify the largest sizes.

headline.purpose: Section and page headings (h2/h3). Geist, 700 weight, text-3xl–text-5xl, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and taglines. Geist, 400 weight, 1.6 line-height, max-w-[65ch].

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, metadata, status readouts. Geist Mono, uppercase, wide tracking. Rationed to at most one eyebrow per three sections — most sections carry none.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for small surfaces (social icon buttons). Dark mode: 0 4px 20px -4px hsl(222 47% 2% / 0.4).

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for content cards. Dark mode: 0 8px 30px -8px hsl(222 47% 2% / 0.5).

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Cobalt-tinted glow on hover, paired with a -translate-y lift. Dark mode: 0 12px 40px -12px hsl(217 91% 63% / 0.35).

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Ring + deep glow reserved for the desktop mode's focused window (inline in window-frame.tsx).

motion.name: ease-scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Default ease for GSAP scroll reveals, hero entrance, and magnetic hover (src/lib/gsap.ts EASE).

motion.name: ease-snappy
motion.purpose: Faster settle for kinetic-type entrances — hero headline word reveal, About intro (src/lib/gsap.ts EASE_SNAPPY).

motion.name: ease-stack-scrub
motion.purpose: Required linear easing for scrub-driven ScrollTrigger tweens — the Protocol sticky-stack (src/lib/gsap.ts EASE_STACK_SCRUB).

motion.name: sticky-stack-scrub
motion.purpose: Scrub value for the Protocol section's genuine pinned sticky-stack sequence (src/lib/gsap.ts STICKY_STACK_SCRUB).

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Easing for pure-CSS Tailwind animate-* utilities (bounce-in, spring-scale, elastic-scale).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Focus rings, color transitions, base interactive state changes.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Card hover, image hover-scale, link-underline growth, badge/social hover.

motion.name: duration-nav-morph
motion.purpose: Nav pill scroll-state transition (transparent to glass panel).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt filled button; the main call-to-action shape. Always fully rounded per the Shape Consistency Lock.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: hsl(217 91% 55%); color: hsl(0 0% 100%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(217 91% 55% / 0.9); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px hsl(217 91% 55% / 0.25); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210 20% 98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(217 91% 55%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95) translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button; transparent fill, hairline border, fills to the neutral accent surface on hover (no second brand color).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: hsl(222 47% 8%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 14% 88%); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(220 14% 93%); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -4px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210 20% 98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(217 91% 55%); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.95) translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field; shares the button's 2px primary focus-ring language, but sits in the small-radius utility tier rather than the pill tier.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: hsl(210 20% 98%); color: hsl(222 47% 8%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 14% 88%); border-radius: 0.375rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(220 10% 40%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210 20% 98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(217 91% 55%); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: The canonical content card — sharp corners (rounded-none), tinted resting shadow, lift + glow on hover. The sharp/pill contrast against buttons is the redesign's core shape signature.
components.html:
Clean Architecture Generator

components.css: .ds-card { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px -8px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.12); transition: box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px hsl(217 91% 55% / 0.25); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-image { height: 10rem; background: hsl(220 14% 93%); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: hsl(222 47% 8%); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(220 10% 40%); margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Pill + Links
components.description: Floating glass nav pill with active/inactive link states. Unchanged mechanics from the previous system, recolored to Cobalt.
components.html: HomeProjects
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(210 20% 98% / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid hsl(220 14% 88% / 0.5); } .ds-nav-link { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(220 10% 40%); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: hsl(222 47% 8%); background: hsl(220 14% 93% / 0.5); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: hsl(217 91% 55%); background: hsl(217 91% 55% / 0.1); }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Monospace uppercase kicker, used above a section headline only when a category label genuinely earns its place. Rationed to at most one per three sections — the redesigned homepage uses zero by default, banking the full budget.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(220 10% 40%); }

narrative.overview: The system reads as a confident, type-driven engineering portfolio rather than a template. Sharp-edged content surfaces, asymmetric offset layouts, and a single cobalt accent replace the previous system's warm-paper/serif "notebook" language. Typography carries the visual weight: bold sans display type (Geist), tight tracking, and word-by-word kinetic reveals do the storytelling that photography would otherwise do — the site is deliberately type/graphic-only, with no photo or avatar anywhere. Underneath the boldness sits the same real technical craft as before: focus rings, hover-lift, GSAP ScrollTrigger-driven motion (including a genuine pinned sticky-stack sequence), and a full alternate "desktop OS" mode (boot screen, window chrome, taskbar) that exists purely to demonstrate engineering depth to the half of the audience qualified to notice it. Playful details — a confetti-triggering logo Easter egg, magnetic cursor-follow links, a hinted Konami code — still signal personality, recalibrated to the new palette.
keyCharacteristics: Bold sans display type (Geist, 700 weight, tight tracking) for all headings; no serif anywhere. Monospace (Geist Mono) for labels, metadata, and code.
Cool, restrained neutrals (cobalt-tinted off-white/near-black) with a single saturated accent — no second brand color.
Sharp corners (rounded-none) on content cards and images; fully rounded (rounded-full) interactive chrome. Desktop-OS window chrome is the one documented exception.
Asymmetric, offset compositions — no centered hero, no 3-equal-column card grids, no two sections sharing the same layout family back-to-back.
A generous, varied section-spacing rhythm (py-20 to py-48, tiered by section role) rather than one flat value repeated everywhere.
A signature desktop-OS "Easter egg" mode (boot screen, draggable windows, taskbar) proving craft depth beyond the surface page.

rules.name: The Singular Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only color permitted to mean "active, selected, or important" — links, focus rings, active nav state, glows. There is no second brand accent; the old Muted Teal has been retired and its CSS variable slot (--accent) now holds a neutral.

rules.name: The Serif-Never Rule
rules.body: No serif typeface is used anywhere on the public site. Emphasis within a headline uses bold or italic of the same Geist face, never a mixed-family word injection.

rules.name: The Tinted-Not-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Shadows never use a plain black/gray value — resting shadows tint to the background hue, hover shadows tint to the accent.

rules.name: The Shape Consistency Lock
rules.body: Interactive chrome (buttons, nav, badges, pills) is always fully rounded; content surfaces (cards, images, panels) are always sharp (rounded-none); inputs sit in a small-radius utility tier. Desktop-OS window chrome is the one documented exception.

dos: Do keep Cobalt as the only color that signals active/selected/important (links, focus rings, active nav, glows) — The Singular Accent Rule.
Do tint shadows to the near-black foreground hue at rest and Cobalt on hover, never plain black — The Tinted-Not-Neutral Rule.
Do use Geist for every text register; reserve bold/italic-of-the-same-face for emphasis, never a mixed serif injection.
Do keep interactive chrome fully rounded and content surfaces sharp (rounded-none) — The Shape Consistency Lock.
Do vary section spacing by role (section-tight/section-standard/section-generous) rather than repeating one py-* value everywhere.
Do gate any new motion on prefers-reduced-motion, matching every existing GSAP animation in the codebase.
Do ration eyebrow labels to at most one per three sections — most sections should carry no eyebrow at all.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated brand color — the --accent token is now a neutral emphasis surface, not a color slot.
Don't use the base shadcn Card primitive's default rounded styling for new content surfaces — match rounded-none + shadow-card/shadow-hover instead.
Don't reuse the same layout family (card grid, list, bento) in two sections back-to-back on the same page — see the homepage's five distinct section families for the pattern.
Don't center the hero or default to a 3-equal-column card grid — both are retired template patterns from the previous system.
Don't use em-dashes anywhere in user-facing copy (headlines, body, labels, alt text) — zero tolerance.
Don't add a custom cursor or new Easter-egg mechanics without matching the recalibrated confetti palette (#2474F5 / #64748B / #FFD43B) and the existing reduced-motion gating pattern.
